Wisconsin Democratic Primary Sees Moderate David Crowley Defeat Progressive Francesca Hong

David Crowley won the Democratic primary for Wisconsin governor, defeating progressive candidate Francesca Hong. The Associated Press reported Crowley's victory, while other outlets analyzed the implications for the Democratic Party and the progressive movement. Politico noted Crowley's strategy of focusing on 'MAGA extremism' to unite a fractured coalition. The New York Times and CNN explored the significance of Hong's defeat for progressive candidates and the Democratic Socialists of America's broader ambitions.
